item.name: KlikBand
item.description:
Daily worship companion for Muslims: prayer times with countdown and alerts, guided dhikr and tasbih, Hijri calendar and Islamic holidays, fasting reminders, Qibla, Asmaul Husna, duas and an Umrah guide.

Any place in the world can be sent with KlikBand's AstroBox plugin, using the Kemenag (Indonesia), Muslim World League, Umm al-Qura or ISNA method.

Open source, free, no account, fully offline. Available in Indonesian, English and Chinese.

Community quick app, not an official Xiaomi product.
